title: Triage interop divergences
description: Each divergence from S3/S4 becomes its own bead citing the RFC/draft text that decides it. crate-jmap bugs get fixed; Stalwart bugs get filed upstream only with Mark's per-item OK.
notes:
2026-11-21 divergences from cyub.3 (Stalwart 1.1.1), recorded via known_divergence (fail under JMAP_INTEROP_STRICT=1): (1) RFC 8620 §3.6.1 unsupported using capability -> notRequest 400 instead of unknownCapability; (2) RFC 8620 §5.3 Identity/set never sends oldState; Identity/set and EmailSubmission/set with nothing changed omit oldState and newState; EmailSubmission/set create has newState but no oldState (Mailbox/set and Email/set correct); (3) consequence: jmap-mail-client email_submission_set fails ClientError::Parse ('missing field newState') because SetResponse requires newState per RFC — leniency would be a design choice; (4) destroy ['#m'] with a creation id from an earlier call -> notFound (RFC 8620 §5.3 ambiguous across calls); (5) Stalwart adds $hasnoattachment itself (not a divergence). Candidates: report 1-2 upstream to Stalwart; decide on 3.
2026-11-21: decision 67. Stalwart takes reports only at support.stalw.art (GitHub issues auto-closed). Merged report drafted at docs/upstream/2026-11-21/stalwart/report.md (both deviations, captured against 1.1.1, RFC quotes checked); waiting for Mark to post it. Client leniency for missing newState in progress.
2026-11-21: unknownCapability->notRequest already reported (support.stalw.art t/2445) and fixed upstream, next weekly release; report.md trimmed to the oldState/newState deviation only (no existing report found by search).
2026-11-21: report posted as https://support.stalw.art/t/2470 (MarkAtwood, Issues category), rewritten plainly at Mark's request. Waiting on a maintainer reply.
2026-11-21 21:41: helpbot on t/2470 confirmed from source (identity/set.rs and submission/set.rs set new_state only after a non-empty batch commit; Identity never sets old_state; Mailbox fills both at context creation), calls it a conformance gap, suggests clients treat missing newState as unchanged. Waiting for a human maintainer.
2026-11-21: decision 67 client side landed: SetResponse.new_state defaults to an empty State when absent; jmap-base-client extract_response warns 'set response has no newState' (method, account_id, missing) except PushSubscription/set. Candidates not changed: CopyResponse/EmailImportResponse/ChangesResponse etc. required states. Note: empty-string sentinel deviates from AGENTS.md public-API rule 2, forced by 'no API change'.
